summary: Amanda Operating Manager Phase 1 (Issue #27): objectives gains typed owner, accountable persona, domain, priority, autonomy class, blocked reason / dependency, wake reason, subject identity, needs_reasoning and state hash (all nullable or defaulted), objective_type adds 'ap', plus the manager_wakes de-duplicated wake outbox. No existing row is changed.

preflight.name: objectives exists (migration 399)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'objectives'

preflight.name: objectives has no Phase 1 columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'objectives' AND column_name IN ('subject_key', 'autonomy_class', 'state_hash', 'owner_kind')

preflight.name: manager_wakes does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'manager_wakes'

expected_changes: Adds nullable objectives columns owner_kind, owner_key, accountable_persona, domain, priority, autonomy_class, blocked_reason, depends_on (jsonb), wake_reason, subject_key, subject_refs (jsonb), state_hash, and needs_reasoning (NOT NULL DEFAULT false).
Replaces objectives_objective_type_check with the same list plus 'ap'; adds CHECKs for owner_kind, domain, priority, autonomy_class, and that a BLOCK states its blocked_reason.
Adds uq_objectives_open_subject (one OPEN objective per subject_key) and idx_objectives_blocked.
Creates manager_wakes (UNIQUE dedup_key, kind/status/outcome CHECKs, two indexes) with SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE for service_role and SELECT for authenticated.
No existing objectives or objective_events row is changed; no other table is touched.

verify.name: existing objectives unclassified (new columns NULL, needs_reasoning false)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM objectives WHERE subject_key IS NOT NULL OR autonomy_class IS NOT NULL OR needs_reasoning

verify.name: open-subject unique index present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'uq_objectives_open_subject'
